Thanks — Wed 6/23 9:30 PDT works for us. Iʼll send a calendar invite for 30 minutes.

Quick answers in advance of the call so you have context:
- MSA: we treat most operational clauses as standard; exceptions are typically around data residency, indemnity caps, and audit windows. We can flag the sections you care about and have legal join if needed.
- Evidence: we have a consolidated folder with SOC2 reports, encryption architecture, and retention policies. Monica (ccʼd) owns the SOC2 artifacts and can outline what we can share pre-signing.
- Timeline: Typical procurement runs 3–4 weeks for standard customers; if you need an accelerated path we can discuss a target and internal SLA exceptions.

Agenda for the 30m: 1) procurement checklist review (10m), 2) MSA section expectations (10m), 3) next steps and doc owners (10m).

I attached a draft MSA (internal copy) to show starting positions. If you can drop any specific clauses you want us to prioritize, thatʼll speed the redline round.

Thanks — invite coming shortly.
